title: Keep published inputs source-faithful and derive their corollaries internally
obstacle: A convenient external package includes a result not actually supplied by the source.
procedure: Expand all source theorem hypotheses and conclusion fields.
Keep only the cited mathematical content in the external port.
Prove specialization, normalization and problem-specific bridges as internal declarations.
verification: Review source text and recursive record fields; an empty axiom report does not justify theorem parameters.
positive_example: The BO accepted root derives L2 from the weight before instantiating the universal Chen interface.
negative_example: A Published... record with the desired compactness or tail bound merely assumes the missing result.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.
